Formats an Engineer name with a small portrait for sortable directory tables.

<pre>{{Engineer table entry|Felicity Farseer|Felicityfarseer.png}}</pre>

Use the table cell's <code>data-sort-value</code> attribute so the row still sorts by the Engineer's name instead of the file name.
